symbols.phrase: Look here at this winding ribbon of sediment; a long, untrodden road calls your name.
See this soaring crane perched on the rim? Distant horizons carry long-awaited news for your spirit.
Here stands a sunlit archway, inviting you to leave old sorrows behind forever.
A ship with billowing sails drifts here; turbulent waters surrender to sudden, beautiful voyages.
A heavy brass key emerges from the darkness; an old closed door will soon unlock.
Behold this steep mountain summit; what felt like an obstacle becomes your greatest viewpoint.

conclusion: Ah, my precious soul, your cup breathes the restless wind of an overdue departure. The sediment whispers that your current life has grown far too small for your spirit, yet fear not this unsteadiness in your chest. As you cross through the archway onto the open path, the soaring crane and the proud ship reveal that unfamiliar shores will heal what familiarity could not. The climb toward the mountain peak will ask for your patience, but the key in your grasp guarantees that every barrier will yield to your stride. Untie your heart from yesterday's shore, for the journey before you is painted in freedom and gold.
